scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && python -m ruff check src tests
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && python -m ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/api && python -m ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
